introHtml: Solar powered banner display accessories let you illuminate your outdoor signage without electrical outlets or extension cords. Whether you are promoting a booth at a trade show or directing traffic at a community event, these accessories use renewable energy to keep your banners visible day and night. Options include solar LED light kits and illuminated frames that work with standard banner sizes. Choose solar powered accessories to reduce your carbon footprint while maintaining high visibility for your messaging.
